solutions.title: Greedy farthest reach
solutions.notes: Track the farthest index reachable so far
solutions.description:
**Approach:** Scan left to right; if you ever stand beyond farthest, fail; else update farthest.

**Example walkthrough:** At index `0` farthest becomes `2`; from `1` farthest becomes `4`, which reaches the end → `true`.
